'''Bristow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] on [[Shramar]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], fighting in the [[Battle of Shramar]] alongside [[Kaye Galfridian]] against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s ground forces.
